findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The searchKey parameter is concatenated directly into a dynamic SOQL query string, which can lead to SOQL injection.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions, which can allow users to access fields they do not have permission to view.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS permissions.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The Apex class does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions for the Contact object and its fields.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in SOQL queries and enforce FLS for field access.

findings.title: FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The Apex class does not validate field-level security for the Contact fields accessed and updated.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce FLS for field access.

findings.title: Sharing mode violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', which ignores record-level sharing rules. This can lead to unauthorized access to records.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce CRUD and FLS checks. This can lead to unauthorized access to fields or objects.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS checks.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants Modify All Data and View All Data, which are powerful system permissions that should only be granted to administrators or integration users with a clear need.
findings.remediation: Remove Modify All Data and View All Data from the permission set unless absolutely necessary and justified.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The guest user profile grants access to the PublicCatalogController class, which can be called by anyone on the internet through the site's Aura endpoint.
findings.remediation: Remove the PublicCatalogController class from the guest user profile's classAccesses, or ensure the class only returns data intended to be public and enforces USER_MODE.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions, allowing users to access data they may not have permission to see.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS permissions.

findings.title: Sharing Violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', ignoring record-level sharing rules.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Guest User Exposure
findings.explanation: The guest user profile has access to the ContactSearchController class, allowing unauthenticated users to query contact data.
findings.remediation: Remove the ContactSearchController class from the guest user profile's classAccesses or ensure the class enforces appropriate sharing and permission checks.
